arStrings.szText: I think this is my fault. I can’t leave Temis though, the situation here is still too unsettled.
Cleon wasn’t a wicked man, and this wasn’t justice. Marcellus has to be stopped.
Please, you know what needs to be done. Send his Morlu hunters running and bring me proof of his death. I wouldn’t ask it of a lesser warrior, but I’ve seen what you can do.
You’ll have the thanks of the city…and mine besides.
